name: ogenticai-reviewer
description: Review a PR against its linked Linear ticket's UAT checklist. Per-item PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/UNVERIFIABLE verdicts on the PR comment, with optional Linear writeback. Same code path as the GitHub Action — verdicts produced locally match what CI would produce on the same SHA.
